credits.title: 17 Years Old and Over
credits.overview: Bagas (Ajun Perwira) really wants to be a musician. After his age of 17 old years, Bagas decides to pursue his dream and finds a way to be a musician. His mother (Ranty Purnamasari) does not approve the decision. Mother also does not approve Bagas’ relationship with Mentari (Sonya Fatmala).

credits.title: Bukan Hanya Mata Ketiga
credits.overview: Vellya, a Balinese teenager, moves to a seaside town with his mother. The bombing in Bali caused Vellya's father to die and Vellya had hearing difficulties.

credits.overview: While celebrating their children's birthdays, Mae and Rendy received shocking news. Sophie announces that she will get married to Kim Bum Park, a Korean man whom she just met for 3 weeks when holidaying in Korea.

credits.title: Love In A Box
credits.overview: Miko plans to break up, chase new experiences, and take the stage for his stand-up debut. But when his act goes off the rails, he turns to a box of mementos from 21 past crushes to prove that love is nothing but a joke.

credits.title: Operation Wedding
credits.overview: When a military dad rules that his oldest daughters must marry first, the youngest sibling leads a mission to get all of her sisters engaged.
